_why: The one place the Node versions the CI and release gates run on are written (#1645).
`ci` is the matrix the herdr and am jobs run; `release` is the exact version the release cut
runs and must be one of `ci`. They are one file because a release-only version hid a real
break: on 24.0-24.13.0 rmSync followed a symlink to a directory and threw, while 24.18
unlinked it, so the same commit passed every PR check on 22 + latest 24 and failed every
release on 24.9.0 for hours (#1645, fixed by #1644's tests). A Node minor can change
filesystem, network or process behaviour, so the release must run a Node a pull request ran.
scripts/node-versions.test.ts enforces the file, the matrix expression and the release pin
together; do not add a Node pin to either workflow outside this file.
